objective: Metti in sicurezza la rete HELIOS isolando i circuiti e colpendo i giunti esposti.

prerequisites: Arena, footprint, valve timing and audiovisual telegraphs approved with declared temporary shapes
actions: Prototype moving pressure sectors and safe paths
Bind valves, exposed joints, damage windows and civilian-route consequence to one simulation state
Produce final sprite, animation and audio only after behavior validation
Integrate IT/EN objectives, checkpoint, retry and save state
tests: Telegraph precedes every pressure hit and remains readable without color
Standing still cannot solve the encounter by absorbing damage
Checkpoint and retry cannot duplicate progress or rewards
Later Lulù route observes the secured civilian passage
closure: Playable in the campaign with own final art/audio, observable cross-route consequence and build-bound runtime plus Android evidence.

objective: Dimostra una rotta sicura proteggendo persone e carichi senza uccidere Sera Venn.

prerequisites: Duo controls, protection objective and non-lethal resolution validated
actions: Prototype mobile cover, signal restoration and cargo safety states
Keep the encounter on foot and distinct from The Ram and Veyra races

Integrate IT/EN dialogue, consequence, checkpoint and retry
tests: Ordinary two-thumb controls can coordinate both roles
No lethal finishing state is possible or communicated

Completion never creates an eighth championship race
closure: Campaign encounter has distinct protection play, final art/audio, canonical outcome, persistent state and build-bound runtime plus Android evidence.

objective: Riconfigura il collaudo sincronizzando due stazioni mentre il ponte e le zone previste si spostano.
